title: Hackers Exploiting Critical Puppet RCE Flaw Affecting Enterprise Management Servers
content_md: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Tuesday added a critical security flaw impacting Perforce Puppet, an enterprise infrastructure-as-code (IaC) and configuration management platform, to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing reports of active exploitation.
